summary: Phase 19 security hardening fully verified. All 11 new phase19 backend tests pass (SEC-001 DoS caps, SEC-002 session scoping, SEC-003 generic errors, P3 headers, payload bounds). Added 5 regression + rate-limit tests (test_phase19_regression_and_rate_limit.py) — all pass: default projection math (lifetime_taxes=7765487.89, ending_net_worth=81426835.12, legacy.after_tax_estate_to_heirs=140350666.22), strategy-sweep best=single/after_tax_estate in [141M,143M], SS optimizer FRA≈4152 for Client/Spouse, Monte Carlo w/ inflation returns inflation.cumulative.{p10,p50,p90,expected}, and /api/strategy-sweep rate-limits to 429 within 20 calls. Frontend verified: UUIDv4 stamped into localStorage['roth-planner-session-token'] on first load, X-Session-Token attached to every /api request (verified via interception), Scenarios tab shows 'No saved scenarios yet.' on fresh session, saving a scenario then clearing localStorage + reload produces a new token and hides the previous scenario (owner scoping enforced end-to-end). All 12 tabs load without console errors.
action_items: Minor: review-request references data-testids 'tab-ss' and 'tab-detail' but actual IDs in Planner.jsx are 'tab-ssopt' and 'tab-cashflow'. Both tabs render and function correctly — this is a documentation/naming mismatch only, no code fix required unless standardization is desired.
critical_code_review_comments: Axios interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js is registered globally on the default axios instance — safe here because the app owns axios, but if a third-party lib imports axios independently it would also send X-Session-Token. Consider using a dedicated axios instance (axios.create) for future-proofing.

getSessionToken() falls back to Math.random() UUID when crypto.randomUUID is unavailable — acceptable for anonymous session scoping (not a security secret), but note this is not cryptographically random on older browsers.
Phase 19 test file uses per-fixture Session with a single X-Session-Token — good pattern; ensures isolation.
seed_data_creation: One test scenario 'TEST_iso_1' created transiently during frontend isolation test; abandoned with session A's token and unreachable from any other session (SEC-002 enforced). Backend cleanup fixture removes owner-scoped test scenarios.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Session token key: 'roth-planner-session-token' in localStorage. All /api requests must carry X-Session-Token: <uuidv4>. /api/scenarios enforces ownership; other endpoints ignore the header but rate-limit per client IP via slowapi. Rate limits (per client IP): projection 30/min, sweep 15/min, strategy-sweep 10/min, ss-optimizer 15/min, montecarlo 30/min, scenarios POST 30/min, insights 10/min, chat 30/min, global 300/min. To reproduce rate-limit test, just fire >10 strategy-sweep calls in <60s from the same IP.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All Phase 19 SEC-001/SEC-002/SEC-003/P3 fixes verified working in preview environment.
